title: CTA · button geometry base
description: Shared geometry and .btn-star base for every CTA variant. Defines .btn (pill shape, height 3.25rem, padding, transition) and .btn-star (icon flex + rotation transition). Variant blocks (cta.btn-primary-ring, cta.btn-secondary-filled) extend this base.
notes: This block has no visual identity of its own — it is a primitive shared by every CTA variant.
Every CTA harness must link cta.btn-base/block.css before the variant block.css.
